name: Agent Custom Setup
audience_feeling: I know which helpers to pin and how to finish a hotload install.
promise: Give agents a versioned registry of custom setups and a hotload pack that wires FULL PCM + FULL CGM with coordination rules.

preferred_terms.ACS: this repository as source of truth for registered setups
preferred_terms.hotload: load order that installs PCM + CGM + coordination runtime
preferred_terms.FULL CGM: all eight modules at 0.5.6 plus human_output_contract (incl. human-output-naming)

avoid: treating Desktop as source of truth
good_examples: Hotload is done only when FULL PCM, FULL CGM 0.5.6 validate, and this runtime all pass.
bad_examples: We pinned HSW and writing-direction, so CGM is done.
status_note: Derived for ACS hotload full-stack pin (Refs #11); owner review pending.
